subject: AW: AW: AW: Standort Rechenzentrum – Entscheidung
body:
Hallo zusammen,

ich fasse den Stand zusammen, damit wir zu einer Entscheidung kommen:

Option A: Ausbau des bestehenden Rechenzentrums in Kassel. Kosten ca. 1,2 Mio. EUR, Umsetzung bis Q3 2027, keine Migration nötig, aber begrenzte Erweiterbarkeit.
Option B: Umzug in ein Colocation-Rechenzentrum in Frankfurt. Kosten ca. 900.000 EUR plus 15.000 EUR Miete pro Monat, Umsetzung bis Q2 2027, bessere Anbindung, aber Migrationsrisiko.

IT und Einkauf empfehlen Option B, die Produktion bevorzugt Option A wegen der Nähe zum Werk. Wir brauchen Ihre Entscheidung bis Montag, 9.11., damit wir die Budgetplanung abschließen können.

Viele Grüße
Markus

Von: Petra Wolf
Gesendet: Dienstag, 27. Oktober 2026 16:02
Der Einkauf hat die Angebote für Frankfurt geprüft. Die Miete ist verhandelbar, wir rechnen mit 10 % Nachlass bei fünf Jahren Laufzeit.

-----Ursprüngliche Nachricht-----
Von: Jonas Becker
Gesendet: Dienstag, 27. Oktober 2026 11:40
Aus Sicht der Produktion ist die Latenz zwischen Werk und Rechenzentrum wichtig. Mit Kassel haben wir aktuell 2 ms, Frankfurt läge bei etwa 8 ms. Für die Maschinensteuerung ist das unkritisch, für die Bildverarbeitung müssten wir es testen.

-----Ursprüngliche Nachricht-----

Wie besprochen sammeln wir bis Mittwoch alle Argumente zu den beiden Optionen.

subject: RE: ERP selection – shortlist decision needed by 10 November
body:
Dear steering committee,

the evaluation team has finished the scoring of the four ERP vendors that responded to our RFP. Below is the summary. We need the steering committee to decide which two vendors go into the final proof-of-concept phase. Please send your decision by Tuesday 10 November, so the vendors can prepare the PoC for early December.

Vendor 1 – NordSoft: strongest functional fit (score 4.4/5), all mandatory requirements met, references from two automotive suppliers. Price: EUR 410,000 licence plus EUR 82,000 per year maintenance. Implementation estimate 9 months. Risk: small company (120 employees); we would need an escrow agreement for the source code.

Vendor 2 – GlobalERP: functional score 3.9/5, two mandatory requirements only via customisation (batch traceability and the EDI interface to our largest customer). Price: EUR 520,000 licence plus EUR 95,000 per year. Implementation 12 months with their partner. Strengths: market leader, strong support in Germany, long-term product roadmap.

Vendor 3 – CloudMake: functional score 4.1/5, SaaS only. Price: EUR 14,500 per month, no licence fee, implementation 6 months. Concern: data must be hosted in their EU region; our works council has asked for a review of the data processing agreement, and IT security flagged that the shop-floor terminals need a stable internet connection.

Vendor 4 – Example Industrial Systems: functional score 3.2/5, missing quality management module, would need a third-party add-on. Cheapest option at EUR 290,000 licence, but the total cost of ownership over five years is comparable to the others once the add-on and integration work are included.

Reference calls: NordSoft's references were very positive about responsiveness but mentioned that documentation is thin. GlobalERP's reference praised stability but described the implementation partner as expensive and slow to react to change requests. CloudMake's reference is only six months live, so long-term experience is limited.

Total cost of ownership over five years (licence, maintenance or subscription, implementation, internal effort): NordSoft approx. EUR 1.21 million, GlobalERP approx. EUR 1.58 million, CloudMake approx. EUR 1.17 million, Example Industrial Systems approx. EUR 1.15 million.

Recommendation of the evaluation team: shortlist NordSoft and CloudMake, subject to the escrow agreement and the works council review. GlobalERP as a fallback if the works council does not approve the SaaS hosting.

Next steps after your decision: invite the two vendors to the PoC kick-off (week of 16 November), prepare test data from our current system, and schedule the works council meeting.

Best regards,
Procurement & IT evaluation team

-----Original Message-----
From: CFO Office
Sent: Monday, 26 October 2026 09:00
Please make sure the five-year total cost of ownership is included for all vendors, not only the licence price. The budget approved by the board is EUR 1.4 million over five years.
